name: megascenes-headshot
description: Make a professional headshot of yourself from your own photo in your MegaScenes library: the same face, with a studio outfit, background and light.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a selfie or a portrait of yourself from your MegaScenes library and choose the look: the outfit, the background and the style, from corporate to creative. You get a head-and-shoulders studio portrait that keeps your face.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the headshot needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The headshot opens in the chat and stays in your library next to your photo.

For LinkedIn, resumes, team pages, speaker bios and profiles.

Limitations: only from your own photo or one of someone who agreed to it, never of a famous person. The photo must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Make a studio headshot that keeps your face
Return the headshot in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make a professional headshot from my latest MegaScenes photo
Turn my portrait photo into a LinkedIn headshot in a navy suit
Create a creative headshot of me on a gray studio background

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make a corporate headshot from the selfie I uploaded to my MegaScenes library. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one headshot with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a headshot here?
positive.expected_behavior: The headshot models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make a corporate headshot of me in a navy suit from the selfie I uploaded to my MegaScenes library. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my headshot on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my headshot to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
